$note: A conformant catalog with NO `defaults` key at all. Every one of the 19 mandated fields is expressed PER UNIT. This fixture is the mechanical proof that the global defaults block is optional and never load-bearing.

work_units.title: Stand up the command centre directory and its append-only event log
work_units.question_or_target: Create the command-center directory with every ledger artifact the spec enumerates and prove the event log is append-only by attempting an in-place rewrite.
work_units.evidence_requirement: two mechanically independent signals: a directory listing showing every enumerated artifact, and a rejected in-place rewrite of the event log recorded with its exact error
tests_required: both-states control: the append-only assertion must FAIL on a mutable copy of the log and PASS on the real one
every enumerated artifact name from the spec range is present
work_units.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer in a fresh context who re-lists the directory rather than reading this unit's report
work_units.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:CC-0001 emitted only when every enumerated artifact exists, is non-empty, and the append-only control fired on the mutable copy; otherwise FAILED:CC-0001 <classification>
work_units.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot; enumerate at least two alternatives before a third attempt
